chunks.rationale: Restores the blue left edge on the selected thread. It was `box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 0 var(--blue)` on .card[data-active] until the sidebar restyle in 011a629 dropped it; same rule is added to .slimRow[data-active] so Later-shelf rows read the same.
risks: .card[data-multi=true] (blue-soft fill) has no box-shadow of its own, so a selected+multi card shows both the fill and the bar — that is the pre-011a629 behaviour.
